messages:
maria: Quick thread for Friday's webinar logistics \/ follow-ups. A couple of edge cases we hit last time: dropped recording, missing slides link in email, and HubSpot deduping. Can owners for each area confirm? :wave:
alan: I’ll own Zoom ops and recording redundancy. Plan:
- create meeting with practice session on
- cloud recording + local backup on host laptop (record locally as fallback)
- also enable 'record separate audio tracks'
- live transcript + auto-CC
- set cohosts: alan, kevin
- passcode & waiting room on for external domains
- pre-assign breakout rooms via CSV when panelists confirmed
Note: I'll run a 10min dry-run Thurs 9:30am PT and post links.
priya: Reg page + email copy owner here. Reg page fields:
- required: first,last,email,company,role,region
- optional: team_size, primary_use_case
- hidden: utm_campaign, experiment_id
- GDPR checkbox (explicit opt-in) - not prechecked
Confirmation email must include:
1) replay placeholder (link to be updated after recording processed)
2) slides link + high-res dl location
3) 1-click calendar invite to add to calendar
I'll add UTMs: utm_source=email, utm_campaign=webinar_apr_fri
kevin: Post-event routing and HubSpot notes:
- attendees -> email 1h after w/ recording + slides + CTA to book demo
- regs who didn't attend -> email 4h after w/ highlights + recording + 1Q poll
- watch_pct > 60% -> tag 'webinar_apr_hot' and assign to SDR queue
- dedupe rules: use email primary, fallback: md5(domain+name) for import collisions
- hubspot property: webinar_2026_apr=true
claire: Assets and storage:
- slide deck go to GDrive: marketing/webinars/2026-04-23-inference-highlights
- master mp4 -> S3: s3://redwood-marketing/webinars/2026-04-23/master.mp4
- captions (VTT) exported from cloud recording and uploaded to same folder
- retention: marketing copy = 90d, enterprise requests -> storage team will keep snapshot under compliance S3 bucket
ops-bot: zoom-scheduler created meeting 1803019000 "Webinar: Practical Inference Tradeoffs" scheduled 2026-04-23 16:00 UTC  cloud_recording=on, live_transcript=on, passcode=required.
maria: Two quick fail-safes: 1) Alan, please confirm you'll trigger local recording if cloud fails (hotkey + note in runbook). 2) Priya, please include placeholder text in confirmation email like: "Replay will be available within 2 hours; we’ll replace this link once processing completes."
alan: Confirmed. Local recording checklist in runbook snippet:
```
Host: Record -> Local
Check disk space >= 10GB
Start recording 5m before start
If cloud failed: upload local mp4 to S3 then post link to reg email placeholder
```
kevin: I'll add a small workflow to HubSpot: a webhook will check recording status and replace placeholder link when processing done. Will also add a dedupe step in the import.
priya: I'll put the placeholder copy in the confirmation + follow-up drafts now. Also adding a small note: "If you need slides sooner, reply to this email and we’ll send them" for sales leads.
maria: Action summary:
- alan: Zoom dry-run Thurs 9:30am PT, local recording fallback, export VTT post-event
- priya: reg page live, confirmation + follow-up copy with replay placeholder
- kevin: HubSpot webhook to swap links, dedupe import rules, SDR assignment tag
- claire: upload slides & master mp4 to GDrive + S3 after event
I'll schedule the rehearsal calendar and drop the runbook link. Thanks all! :rocket:
